title: Kimberly Camera, Founder of Coastal K9 and Pest Solutions
description: Kimberly Camera founded Coastal K9 and Pest Solutions in Windsor, SC: 28+ years handling working dogs, FEMA US&R canine roots and four detection certifications.

hero.lead: Founder of Coastal K9 and Pest Solutions, a family-owned canine detection and pest management company in Windsor, South Carolina.

body:
Kimberly Camera founded Coastal K9 and Pest Solutions after 28+ years handling working dogs, beginning with FEMA Urban Search and Rescue, and 27 years in wildlife management and education. She came to this work from an unusual direction — canine work for FEMA Urban Search & Rescue, wildlife tagging, and falconry — and she is comfortable saying on the record when the evidence for something is thin.

Her story

Kim spent 28+ years handling working dogs, from FEMA search and rescue to pest detection, with 15 of those years in detection dog training. That background shaped how she runs the company today: our program grew out of FEMA Urban Search and Rescue canine work, live-find and cadaver-recovery training built on precision and accountability.

Her dream is to build a first-class environmental detection program rooted in pest management and extermination: detection teams working side by side with pest professionals, making their jobs easier, delivering faster results, and focusing and reducing the use of pesticides and rodenticides.

Today Coastal K9 and Pest Solutions is a family-owned, fully licensed South Carolina pest control company based on 12 acres in Windsor, SC, just outside Aiken. The philosophy is direct: detection before treatment, every time. Locally the company works across the Central Savannah River Area and the South Carolina Midlands; nationally it runs canine rodent detection programs for multi-site operators.

It takes a village to be successful, and Coastal K9 and Pest Solutions has an entire city surrounding us and helping us succeed.

How she works

Her public position is that detection is only useful when it is honest: she publishes what the research supports, states where it stops, and corrects industry claims that cannot be sourced — including several that are commercially convenient for her own company.

Certified K9 detection is the intelligence that drives every program — identifying exactly where pest pressure exists so that rodenticide and pesticide application is focused, targeted, and justified by data. Every bed bug alert is confirmed visually, so only affected areas are treated.

She will not stage the work for a camera, either. A detection dog indicates on target odour that is actually present, and a handler who cues a dog to indicate on a clean room is teaching that dog to lie for the rest of its working life.

Credentials & certifications

Her detection teams hold NESDCA, WDDO, CPDA and ICRWDA credentials. Verify each one directly with the certifying body.

FEMA US&R Roots

Canine work for FEMA Urban Search and Rescue: live-find and cadaver-recovery training built on precision and accountability.

Verify at FEMA.gov

NESDCA

National Entomology Scent Detection Canine Association — the recognized certifying body for bed-bug and entomology scent-detection canine teams.

Verify at NESDCA.com

WDDO

World Detection Dogs Organization — independent standards and certification for professional detection-dog teams.

Verify at WDDO.org

CPDA

Canine Professional Detection Association — recognizing skilled, professional canine pest detection.

Verify at CaninePestDetection.org

ICRWDA

International Casino Resort Working Dogs Association — working K9 detection standards and community.

Verify at ICRWDA.org

Licensed pest control technician

Pairing certified detection with legitimate, targeted treatment.

Recognition

Kim is a recipient of the NPMA Women’s Impact Award, presented by the National Pest Management Association and sponsored by FieldRoutes, which recognizes women making significant contributions to the pest management industry.

The rest of the company’s recognition and industry roles are on awards and recognition.
